title: Family Assistance Legislation Amendment (Child Care Measures) Bill (No. 2) 2014
short_title: Family Assistance Legislation Amendment (Child Care Measures) Bill (No. 2) 2014

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would freeze the income thresholds for the Child Care Benefit at their 30 June 2014 levels for three years from 1 July 2014.
It amends the A New Tax System (Family Assistance) Act 1999 to stop indexation of those thresholds until 1 July 2017.
The standard hourly rate, minimum hourly amount and multiple child loadings for the Child Care Benefit would still be indexed each year by the Consumer Price Index.
changes: Freezes Child Care Benefit income thresholds at 30 June 2014 amounts for three income years starting 1 July 2014.
Defers the first indexation of these thresholds to 1 July 2017.
Maintains annual CPI indexation of the Child Care Benefit standard hourly rate, minimum hourly amount and multiple child loadings.
summary.affected: Families receiving the Child Care Benefit.
